title: Which file service?
claim: The clients, the protocol and the file server in use today decide which AWS file service fits.
alt: A decision ladder: Windows and SMB lead to FSx for Windows, NetApp or NFS and SMB to ONTAP, HPC on S3 data to Lustre, ZFS to OpenZFS, everything else to Amazon EFS.

rungs.q: Windows clients, SMB and Active Directory?
NetApp today, or NFS and SMB together?
HPC or ML jobs on data in S3?
Moving ZFS or another Linux file server?
